arguments.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY status
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders
  FROM orders
)
SELECT
  status,
  order_count,
  ROUND(order_count * 100.0 / total_orders, 2) AS share_pct,
  total_orders
FROM status_counts
CROSS JOIN totals
ORDER BY order_count DESC, status
